commits.message:
A colour transition's frame is worked out from its time and cells alone (rich-animation-27tq.ws0)

ownChange kept each cell's change in a closure Map, settled in the first
frame that listed it, so a seek, reverse or scrub over an element whose
cells changed drew a later frame's settlement for an earlier time, and one
transition on two elements shared one record keyed by row:col. The record
and order()'s place cache are gone; each frame spreads its cells over the
order it lists. Cost, kept on purpose: a cell of an element that grows mid
transition may move its start.

A Viewport is scroll state; content is drawn through it with showing (rich-protocol-9xcs.tcy) (#511)

* A Viewport is scroll state; content is drawn through it with showing (rich-protocol-9xcs.tcy)

Viewport no longer takes content or renders itself: `new Viewport(options)`
holds the scroll position, and `showing`/`showingLines` are the one way to
draw through it. The placeholder content half its callers built
(`new RichText("")`, `EMPTY`) is gone, and so is the content a ListView's
viewport held and ignored.

Viewport drops out of the exported-renderable gates (held, ascii-only,
line-ends); their ListView rows still draw through `showing`.

* Review: docs and held check follow Viewport.showing; tests name the Viewport viewport (rich-protocol-9xcs.tcy)

- docs/protocol.md, docs/viewport.md: a Viewport no longer renders or is
  held; the content shown through it is.
- held.test.ts: Viewport.showing joins VARIANTS, restoring the held/onPresent
  check the removed Viewport row carried.
- Rejected: a migration note for the (content, options) -> (options)
  constructor. No changelog exists, the type rejects the old call, and the
  repo keeps no back-compat shims.
